title: epan: constify the header_field_info in the field_info
description:
The header_field_info should never be changed from the
field_info, as it's a pointer to the registered hfi
information and shared by all fields that use the same hfi.

We don't actually do so anywhere, but make the pointer
const to assure that we don't.
